scope: Independent static review, immutable receipt/map verification and six real kernel10 SquashFS-to-ext4/systemd production-loop fixtures. Hardware watchdog/storage/ASUS backend explicitly substituted.

findings.resolution: Verified procfs SysRq b preferred over RB_AUTOBOOT, which invokes BCM watchdog shutdown; direct reboot is last resort without a watchdog-backup guarantee.
Retain worker PID until confirmed reap; no overlapping collector; bounded worker failure latches no-feed.
Exact current native sshd executable/process lifetime/unit/argv matcher; wrong-config daemon remained reachable over real SSH before next collector rejected it, without a competing helper timeout.
All 208 critical regular files and metadata match final archive with enabled guardian generated policy.
Bounded /proc enumeration replaces unavailable children file; preserves complete direct-child start-time snapshot and rechecks lifetime/executable at acceptance.

Only signal unreaped helper; clean timeout returns incomplete sample only after confirmed reap. STARTING can retry inside original 300s deadline, HEALTHY incomplete sample expires. Unreapable worker remains 6s/6.5s bounded hard failure.
Builder and exporter reject optimized Python before argument processing or build directory creation; seven negative gate tests passed.

actual_loop_observations: STARTING systemctl capture timeout (1502ms against unchanged1500ms limit) was cleanly reaped; later complete samples reached HEALTHY without resetting startup deadline.
Healthy wrong-argv injection produced only SSH bit loss after confirmed alternate daemon login, then no-feed and mock40s reset.
Worker hang exited124 with no result after6032ms, latched failure and stopped feeding.
Metadata readonly-bit loss was explicitly injected before metadata recheck failure.
LAN lease expiry retained local health yet expired on reason6.
Prearm refusal restored vendor fixture PID1; ARM failure selected verified-proc emergency fault sink and never executed vendor fallback.

historical_nonaccepted_runs.disposition: Fixture user-sessions/PAM readiness and padded storage grammar prevented useful health; retained failed artifact.
Real kernel10 lacks CONFIG_PROC_CHILDREN; old collector could never identify ASUS direct child.
Collector failed before healthy; original log lacks precise helper-exit diagnosis. Not accepted or attributed solely to load.
Independent retry reproduced early collector failure; retained, not accepted.
Proof raced Type=simple sshd listener startup; connection refused, despite normal later listen.
Run completed, but daemon-reload caused health command timeout before wrong-argv injection; explicitly excluded from wrong-argv acceptance.

limitations: Mock watchdog uses real elapsed40s timer but never opens physical watchdog or proves BCM reset/bootloader behavior.
Regular-file storage and synthetic broker/ASUS process topology do not validate Broadcom WiFi, AiMesh, Ethernet/AI hardware services.
Gate-enabled binary is build-authorized for a guarded future trial, not evidence of physical deployment, permanent boot acceptance or runtime success.
No automatic boot commit or permanent observer-free acceptance path exists in this frozen release.
